goal_summary: Travel week (no gym/weights) — general fitness, provisional until onboarding

weeks.focus: consistency on the road: running + bodyweight strength, conservative volume

sessions.detail: 25-30 min easy run, conversational pace (RPE 3-4). New city = flat, simple out-and-back route.

Bodyweight full-body circuit, 3 rounds: 12 squats, 10 push-ups (elevate hands if needed), 10 reverse lunges/leg, 30s side plank/side, 15 glute bridges, 10 chair/bench dips. 60-90s rest between rounds.
Rest — walking around town counts. 10-min evening mobility optional.
30 min: 10 easy + 4 x (2 min comfortably-hard RPE 6-7 / 90s easy) + 6 easy. Effort-based, no pace target needed while traveling.
Bodyweight strength B, 3 rounds: 10 tempo squats (3s down), 8-10 pike or decline push-ups, 12 split squats/leg, 40s plank, 15 single-leg glute bridges/leg, 20 calf raises. Finish: 5 min hip mobility.
45-50 min easy long run (or long brisk hike/walk if legs are tired). All conversational.
20-30 min walk + 10 min mobility: hip flexor stretch, figure-4, calf stretch, thoracic opener - 60-90s each.
